board_events.text: 00 · HEALTH — WHO: physical + mental + social well-being, not merely the absence of disease. Factors: genetic, infections, lifestyle.
01 · DISEASES — bacterial: typhoid (Salmonella typhi, Widal, small intestine), pneumonia (alveoli), plague, diphtheria. Viral: common cold (rhino viruses, NOT the lungs).
Protozoan: malaria (haemozoin), amoebiasis (LARGE intestine). Helminthic: ascariasis, filariasis. Fungal: ringworm.
02 · IMMUNITY — Innate (non-specific, 4 barriers) vs Acquired (specific, memory) → Active vs Passive. B = antiBodies = humoral. T = cell-mediated = graft.

03 · ABUSE — addiction = psychological; dependence = physiological (withdrawal); tolerance = higher doses. Opioid ← Papaver (latex) · Cannabinoid ← Cannabis · Cocaine ← Erythroxylum · Nicotine → adrenal → BP.
The three mechanisms the exams treat as derivations: the Plasmodium life cycle, HIV replication, and carcinogenesis.

Mnemonics: Anopheles-mAlaria · Culex-eleCephantiasis · Aedes-Dengue/Yellow · 'Sporozoite IN, gametocyte OUT' · Active=Athlete, Passive=Parcel · placenta=IgG, first=IgM, milk=IgA · Poppy down, Coca up, Cannabis cardio.

segments.text: <excited>And that is the chapter. So let me put all four subtopics on one board — because you have now seen every piece of this, and the point of a cheat sheet is not to teach you anything new. It is to show you how little there actually is, once it is arranged.

Subtopic zero zero, health. The W H O definition: physical plus mental plus social well-being, and not merely the absence of disease. And the three factors that determine it: genetic, infections, lifestyle. That definition is a one-mark question almost every year, and the 'not merely' clause is the half people drop.

Subtopic zero one, the diseases, sorted by pathogen kingdom. Bacterial: typhoid — Salmonella typhi, Widal test, small intestine. Pneumonia — the alveoli. Plague and diphtheria. Viral: the common cold, from rhino viruses, in the nose and passage and never the lungs.

Protozoan: malaria, and haemozoin is what gives you the recurring fever. Amoebiasis — large intestine, and that contrast against typhoid's small intestine is worth a mark on its own. Helminthic: ascariasis and filariasis. Fungal: ringworm. Five kingdoms, ten diseases, one hand.

Subtopic zero two, immunity. Innate — non-specific, four barriers. Acquired — specific, with memory — and it alone splits into active and passive. And the mapping that decides half the questions: B equals antiBodies equals humoral. T equals cell-mediated equals graft rejection.

Subtopic zero three, abuse. Addiction is psychological. Dependence is physiological, with withdrawal. Tolerance is the dose climbing. And the four lines: opioid from Papaver, the latex. Cannabinoid from Cannabis. Cocaine from Erythroxylum. Nicotine, to adrenal, to blood pressure.

And in the dark band across the middle, the three mechanisms the exams treat as derivations rather than recall. The Plasmodium life cycle — bite, sporozoite, liver, red blood cells and fever, gametocytes, mosquito gut for the sexual phase, salivary glands. H I V replication — retrovirus, reverse transcriptase, integration, the macrophage factory, helper T destroyed, immunity collapses. And carcinogenesis — contact inhibition lost, proto-oncogene to oncogene.

Those three are where the marks concentrate, and they are the three you should be able to walk out loud, in order, with every stage named. If you can narrate those three cycles without the board, you have the spine of the chapter.

<whisper>And the mnemonics, all of them, in one place. Anopheles for mAlaria. Culex for eleCephantiasis. Aedes for Dengue and Yellow fever. Sporozoite in, gametocyte out. Active equals athlete, passive equals parcel. Placenta is I g G, first is I g M, milk is I g A. Poppy puts you down, coca charges you up, cannabis hits the cardio. Every one of those was earned in a section, and every one of them is faster than remembering. That is the chapter — go and take it apart on a blank page, and see which line you cannot say.

<excited>और यही पूरा chapter है। तो चारों subtopics एक board पर रख देता हूँ — क्योंकि आप इसका हर टुकड़ा देख चुके हैं, और cheat sheet का मक़सद कुछ नया सिखाना नहीं है। मक़सद ये दिखाना है कि सजाने के बाद इसमें असल में कितना कम है।

Subtopic zero zero, health। W H O की definition: physical plus mental plus social well-being, और सिर्फ़ absence of disease नहीं। और इसे तय करने वाले तीन factors: genetic, infections, lifestyle। वो definition लगभग हर साल one-mark सवाल है, और 'not merely' वाला clause ही वो आधा है जो लोग छोड़ देते हैं।

Subtopic zero one, diseases, pathogen kingdom से sorted। Bacterial: typhoid — Salmonella typhi, Widal test, small intestine। Pneumonia — alveoli। Plague और diphtheria। Viral: common cold, rhino viruses से, nose तथा passage में और फेफड़ों में कभी नहीं।

Protozoan: malaria, और haemozoin ही recurring fever देता है। Amoebiasis — large intestine, और typhoid के small intestine से वो contrast अपने आप में एक mark का है। Helminthic: ascariasis और filariasis। Fungal: ringworm। पाँच kingdoms, दस diseases, एक हाथ।

Subtopic zero two, immunity। Innate — non-specific, चार barriers। Acquired — specific, memory के साथ — और सिर्फ़ यही active तथा passive में बँटती है। और वो mapping जो आधे सवाल तय करती है: B बराबर antiBodies बराबर humoral। T बराबर cell-mediated बराबर graft rejection।

Subtopic zero three, abuse। Addiction psychological है। Dependence physiological है, withdrawal के साथ। Tolerance है dose का चढ़ना। और चार lines: opioid Papaver से, latex से। Cannabinoid Cannabis से। Cocaine Erythroxylum से। Nicotine, फिर adrenal, फिर blood pressure।

और बीच की गहरे रंग की पट्टी में, वो तीन mechanisms जिन्हें exams recall नहीं, derivation मानते हैं। Plasmodium की life cycle — bite, sporozoite, liver, red blood cells और fever, gametocytes, sexual phase के लिए mosquito की gut, salivary glands। H I V replication — retrovirus, reverse transcriptase, integration, macrophage factory, helper T तबाह, immunity ढह गई। और carcinogenesis — contact inhibition खोया, proto-oncogene से oncogene।

इन्हीं तीन पर marks जमा हैं, और यही तीन हैं जिन्हें आपको ज़ोर से, क्रम में, हर stage का नाम लेते हुए चल पाना चाहिए। अगर आप इन तीन cycles को board के बिना सुना सकते हैं, तो chapter की रीढ़ आपके पास है।

<whisper>और mnemonics, सब के सब, एक जगह। Anopheles for mAlaria। Culex for eleCephantiasis। Aedes for Dengue और Yellow fever। Sporozoite in, gametocyte out। Active बराबर athlete, passive बराबर parcel। Placenta है I g G, पहली है I g M, दूध है I g A। Poppy puts you down, coca charges you up, cannabis hits the cardio। इनमें से हर एक किसी section में कमाया गया था, और हर एक याद करने से तेज़ है। यही chapter है — जाइए और इसे एक ख़ाली पन्ने पर खोलकर देखिए, और पता कीजिए कौन सी line आप नहीं बोल पाते।
